protocol_metadata.about: Theo Network thUSD is a yield-bearing RWA stablecoin pegged to the US dollar. Users mint thUSD by depositing USDC or other accepted assets; the protocol deploys capital into a delta-neutral gold strategy (long tokenized gold via thGOLD, short CME gold futures) to generate yield. Holders can stake thUSD into sthUSD (a liquid staking receipt accruing yield, with a roughly two-week unstaking queue). The governance stack consists of a Timelock contract, a 4-of-6 Operator multisig, and a Guardian address for emergency pausing.
